content: It includes research on topics such as eosinophilic folliculitis, pruritus, tinea infections, herpes zoster, scabies, molluscum contagiosum, oropharyngeal candidiasis, and Stevens-Johnson syndrome, among others. The references also cover the efficacy of treatments like antiretroviral therapy, UVB phototherapy, antifungal medications, and antiviral drugs, as well as their impact on quality of life and disease progression in HIV-infected individuals. Additionally, the list includes studies on the global burden of skin diseases, management strategies, and the role of specific therapies in improving patient outcomes.
